title: Roadmap
subtitle: What we're working on and what comes next

vision.sharedBase: Lines of Battle is a tactical strategy game with simultaneous turns: each player plans a move, then every move resolves at once. We're working on two versions that share that base: Lines of Battle <twoD>2D</twoD> (Web & Mobile), free and focused on online ranked matches, and Lines of Battle <threeD>3D</threeD> (Steam), a separate paid desktop game with historical campaigns and longer battles.
vision.separateGames: What you learn carries over, but <twoD>2D</twoD> and <threeD>3D</threeD> are separate games with different engines and multiplayer systems. Web and Mobile players can match together in 2D; 3D multiplayer stays on Steam.

twoD.title: Lines of Battle 2D
twoD.focus: Free on Web, Android, and iOS.
twoD.intro: This is the game you can play now. It is free and funded through cosmetics and convenience features that don't affect match outcomes. Some of this work is underway and the rest is planned. You can follow it on our <projectLink>public GitHub project</projectLink>.

items.name: Quality and stability
items.description: Bug fixes, performance work, backend changes, testing, and balance updates.

items.name: Controls
items.description: Making the controls work better across mobile and PC.

items.name: New team modes
items.description: More multiplayer options and team-based formats.

items.name: Competition and fair play
items.description: More work on matchmaking, rankings, smurfing, and multi-accounting.

items.name: Player progression
items.description: Long-term goals, milestones, and ways to show player progress.

items.name: Social features
items.description: More tools for playing with other people, including more work on coalitions.

items.name: Development support
items.description: Cosmetics, convenience features, and credits for the people who help fund development.

items.name: New eras
items.description: More historical content over time. Each new era will be separate and optional.

threeD.title: Lines of Battle 3D
threeD.focus: A separate paid game for Steam.
threeD.intro: Lines of Battle 3D is a separate desktop game with historical single-player campaigns and longer battles.

items.name: The same battle system
items.description: The 2D battle system brought into 3D. The presentation changes, but the tactical base stays the same.

items.name: 3D engine
items.description: Built with the open-source Godot engine.

items.name: Campaigns
items.description: Historical single-player missions, strategic choices, progression, and Steam achievements.

items.name: Steam multiplayer
items.description: Online matches on Steam, with friends and invites.

items.name: Tactical AI
items.description: More work on the computer opponent for campaigns and battles, building on the AI already used in 2D.

items.name: Modding
items.description: Planned tools and Steam Workshop support for sharing maps, scenarios, units, and eras.

items.name: More eras and campaigns
items.description: Additional eras and campaign content over time.

closing.title: About this roadmap
closing.parallel: This is what we're working on and what we want to work on next. Both versions move forward in parallel.
closing.studio: We're Sophie Games, a small indie studio. Plans can change as we work.
closing.thanks: Thanks for playing and following the project.
